I wrote those three up as 'unwalked, not clean' — FALSE. They are unwalked BY security_analyst; riskAnalyst walked all three live on 2026-08-22 and the observations were already in this asset's own frontmatter. I read a peer's absence as the world's absence without opening my own file. TWO FACTS CARRY THE MARK UP. (1) Live L1 crvUSD HAS NO UPGRADE SURFACE, measured not assumed: non-proxy bytecode, admin() reverts, five proxy/beacon slots zero — and the control survives into the sentence, because minter() ANSWERED on the same address in the same pass, so a reverting admin() is evidence rather than an unanswered call. (2) L1 authority terminates at a 7-DAY VOTE WITH A 7-DAY FLOOR: verified Ownership Voting source has no voteTime setter and _canExecute refuses while the vote is open, so even upgrading the Voting app must itself first clear a 7d vote. That is a floor on the FIRST authority action, not a setting — the strongest single fact on this axis. ⚠️ THE DOCK IS THE MULTI-CHAIN AUTHORITY SURFACE, AND IT IS FOUR DIFFERENT COUNTERPARTIES, NOT ONE. Token-scoped adverse leg is ARBITRUM: beacon contract-upgrade, 9-of-12 Safe, timelock none, floor none, reach FULL, beside a 3d L1-alias to the same executor. Per the undelayed-admin rubric the dock is the ABSENCE OF A REACTION WINDOW, and a 9-of-12 quorum does not offset it — quorum bounds who must agree, not how much notice a holder gets, which is zero. ⚠️ THE OP-STACK CHAINS ARE RECORDED BUT DELIBERATELY NOT THE PRIMARY DOCK, following this report's own standing rule: on fraxtal, optimism and base the token has NO local admin and the authority is the chain's L2StandardBridge ProxyAdmin, which admins EVERY OP Stack predeploy — attributing a chain property to one token's layer would overstate this asset and hide the same risk from every other bridged asset. It is nonetheless the numerically weakest key set anywhere in this walk: fraxtal's bridge ProxyAdmin owner is a 3-of-5 Safe whose five owners are all EOAs, with no timelock. WHY 5.5 AND NOT 6.0: the half-notch is the FRAGMENTATION ITSELF, which IS a token property rather than a chain one — crvUSD's authority resolves to four unrelated counterparties (Curve DAO, Arbitrum, the OP Foundation/Security Council pair, and Frax-side operators), and signer_independence is UNVERIFIED at every one of them. WHY NOT LOWER: L1 is immutable, L1 minting authority sits behind an unshortenable 7d floor with sole-holder EXECUTE_ROLE and passing negative controls, and no OP-Stack leg is a crvUSD-specific grant.
